name: inbox-page-header
title: Inbox page header
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Breadcrumb, large title, subtitle, outline actions, and a notice bell. It is not the project page header.

meta.descriptionEs: Miga, título grande, subtítulo, acciones de contorno y campana. No es el encabezado de proyecto.

meta.usage: <InboxPageHeader crumbs={[{ label: "Espacio", href: "#espacio" }, { label: "Mensajes" }]} title="Mensajes" subtitle="2 sin leer" actions={[{ id: "chat", label: "Nuevo chat" }]} bellLabel="Avisos" bellCount={3} />

api.name: crumbs
api.description: The last crumb is the current page.

api.name: title / subtitle
api.description: Page title and the quiet line under it.

api.name: actions
api.description: Outline buttons. The host decides what they open.

api.name: bellLabel / bellCount
api.description: Notice button. The count uses the primary token.
